violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 10/15/2026

Cut melon and yogurt observed held at 45-49 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Melon was cut 2 hours prior, and was placed in walk in cooler to chill. Yogurt at 49 degrees F was disposed. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026

The open reach in case was not in good repair, not maintaining foods at 41 degrees or below on some shelves. Foods requiring refrigeration are not to be stored on affected shelves until it is functioning properly. Service was called during inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026

Raw animal foods (such as eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as cooked eggs) in the walk-in refrigerator in the market. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/18/2025

Spinach and potato pastries observed held at 69-70 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Disposed. New Violation. Correct By: 11/18/2025
Turkey bacon observed marked with a date exceeding 7 days. Disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/18/2025
